Episode 145. Premonition (7)
For the Runcandel faction watching all of this from outside the Sword Emperor Castle,
It was truly a series of shocks.

If it was just about annihilating the enemies, it could have been possible even without Rosa stepping in, just by deploying the riders, some Black Knights, or the first line of the Black Sword Society.
However, keeping every one of our allies alive in the process was a different level of challenge.
Silence filled the council room.
Everyone seemed to forget what to say, recalling the divine power shown by Jin.
The elders coughed awkwardly, looking at Rosa for cues.
"The 12th Rider is constantly showing shocking scenes. What a formidable power indeed."
"What he showed when he declared the return of the magic sword was nothing. Now, we can't even denigrate the 12th Rider's magic sword with the value of orthodoxy..."
Ran, Vigo, Myu, and Anne were also in the council room.
While the brothers were constantly shaking their heads or nodding, unable to escape from the shock, the sisters wore expressionless faces.
Rosa looked at the sisters.
'After I knocked Joshua down, those two have definitely changed somewhere.'
Rosa had never shown interest in Myu and Anne before.
Just as she always had with other children who failed to stand out.
Among them, Myu and Anne were especially insignificant.
It was even a waste of time to step on or scold them to stimulate them.
However, after that day, their demeanor changed too much.
If it were the original two, they should still be running wildly without understanding the situation, talking nonsense, but their calm demeanor was odd.
Therefore, Rosa recently kept them by her side and watched them.
'They weren't the types to gain weight through some enlightenment.'
What made her daughters change?
'They maintain their composure even after seeing the overwhelmingly dominant figure of the youngest... However, they don't seem to have given up everything waiting for the day they die.'
Rosa soon drew a conclusion.
'It seems they've met a prophet. Therefore, they might believe that a power greater than what the youngest has shown is with them.'
Rosa gathered her gaze and opened her mouth.
"There will be constraints."
The murmuring ones stopped talking.
"If the youngest could use such power without any constraints, the succession war of the family would have ended long ago."
"That's... right."
"Exactly. The 12th Rider is a contractor of the shadow, he must have borrowed the power of Solderet through some conditions."
"Weren't there reports that he used an artifact? That could be a divine object."

"Also, the youngest wouldn't have known that he could use that much power. If he had known, he would have revealed that power as soon as the war began. Unlike before the declaration of the magic sword's return, the youngest has no need to hide his power now."
Those gathered in the council room nodded.
There were contracts, and if there was divine help, the power was acceptable.
Runcandel is a family that's distant from divine contracts, and everyone was just unable to think of that because they were all too shocked.
"The first round ended with a perfect victory for the Sword Emperor Castle. But Zipfel is unlikely to give up that white stone."
The council room door opened, and two Black Knights entered.
"Acting Head of the family, we have confirmed the movement of Zipfel's troops."
"The scale?"

"Over fifty airships including Kojec, it's not precisely confirmed, but we estimate that at least three hundred top magicians, including the Ghost Squad, are on board. The total command is taken by Octavia Zipfel, but we can't exclude the possibility that Kelliark Zipfel might be there."
"Kelliark Zipfel...?"
"Hmm."
It was not yet certain, it was just a report that it could be.
But the second wave of reinforcements was of a scale that would not be strange even if Kelliark was there.
Kelliark Zipfel.
The leader of the world's number one and the pinnacle of magic.
For him to move directly from Zipfel was the same as Chiron coming forward from Runcandel.
Rosa's eyes narrowed.
"What's the basis for Kelliark possibly participating?"
"We have spotted the Fire Dragon Kadun leaving the first wizard tower. In addition, we have confirmed that the composition of the wizards of the first tower has quickly changed to the second line."
"Then it's almost certain that Kelliark will come forward."
"I think so too, Acting Head."
"How long will it take to arrive at the Sword Emperor Castle?"
"Two days. It seems that the teleportation ability shown in the previous Gaipa military road and this war's first round is not usable."
"We don't know that technique. It seems there's some kind of limit to it."
Once again, a heavy silence fell.
Runcandel and Zipfel have often had battles, big and small.
The thousand-year-long battles were now more akin to daily life than war.
The fight had peaked when Chiron and Kelliark were young.
When they hadn't yet ascended to the head of the family, the two families had fought more fiercely than ever.
And after they each became the head of the family, they entered a period of stability.

From then on, whenever the heads of the families directly confronted each other, one side would surely come to an end, and the other side would also be on the verge of destruction. There was certainty in that.
Therefore, Chiron and Kelliark rarely led their families into battle.
Even if they occasionally went to war, the moment they appeared, any battle ended instantly.
The two were literally the absolute beings of the world.
And now Kelliark is stepping forward himself.
He is heading for the Sword Emperor Castle, not Huphester, but blocking him meant a full-scale war.
Everyone was concerned about a full-scale war as soon as his name came up, but Rosa thought differently.

"Kelliark, unlike the head of the family, prioritizes negotiation. Although he is in the Black Sea, he would not dare to engage in a full-scale war with us without the head of the family's approval. Have you all forgotten? He fears the head of the family."
Rosa judged that Kelliark was coming to negotiate with her personally.
"However, we cannot completely rule out a full-scale war. Black Knights, go to the Black Sea immediately and report the situation to the head of the family."
Since Chiron would have already entered deeper than the heart of the Black Sea, even the Black Knights could not report quickly.
They might not even be able to meet at all.
However, Rosa deliberately ordered as if the report would definitely reach him, and the Black Knights immediately understood her intention.
"Yes, ma'am!"

"Also, gather all the Black Knights except the reporter, the execution knights, the first line of the Black Sword Association, the Guardian Knights, all riders, and put the allies on standby. Be ready to move according to the war scenario as soon as my order falls."
"Understood!"
Some of the elders of the Black Sword Association and the scribes hurriedly left the council room to carry out Rosa's orders.

"A full-scale war is something we can't rule out, but the important thing is not that, it's the white stone. It was already proven when they summoned the fleet in the first round and now again with the arrival of large reinforcements. The white stone is something they can't do without. However, we still don't know what it is."
"Shall we send someone to the Sword Emperor Castle?"
At the scribe's words, Rosa shook her head.

"No. If our youngest knew exactly what the white stone is and was certain that it was absolutely necessary for our family, he would have asked for help from the family first. He is likely still making his judgement. Above all, the Mistress of the Labyrinth is with him. We could inadvertently provoke her. We have a couple of days, so let's watch a little longer."

"Hmm, I can't figure out why the 12th generation is not leaving the Sword Emperor's Castle. If their purpose of participating in the war was to rescue Dante Hairan, they should leave when they have the chance, but there's no sign of that happening."
Rosa also found that part strange.

'Logically, our youngest should lead Dante and Hairan's knights to retreat even now. He wouldn't be unaware that a larger reinforcement is coming. At this point, absorbing Hairan and entering a public relations battle to shake up Zipfel and the Empire, and prompting the family to intervene is our youngest's style, but why is he not leaving the Sword Emperor's Castle?'
Is it because he can't leave?
If it's simply a situation where Dante is being stubborn, our youngest would be the type of person to beat him half to death and forcibly make him leave the Sword Emperor's Castle.
The same would be true even if he had to save other knights of Hairan besides Dante.
The youngest that Rosa knew could have made the entire Hairan leave the Sword Emperor's Castle by taking Dante hostage or threatening him even more.
"It's also suspicious that Kinzelo is not moving. According to reports so far, there has been no military movement in the land of the beastmen."
"Like during the Sword Emperor's Castle terror, they could suddenly appear on the battlefield using a dimensional gate. Keep a close eye on them."
What Runcandel didn't know was that Kinzelo currently couldn't use the power of the chieftain.
Therefore, if they were to participate in the Sword Emperor's Castle War, military movement should have already started.

"The last magic used by the 12th generation is the legacy of Liol Zipfel. Regent, perhaps the reason Kelliark is moving is not just because of the white stone. It seems likely that retrieving Liol Zipfel's magic was also included in his purpose. Also, the artifact used by the 12th generation could also be Zipfel's item."
When Telrot Runcandel, the chairman of the House of Commoners, spoke, Rosa nodded.
Rosa accurately read the hidden meaning in his words.
"You have a point. You're worried about our youngest, chairman."
"......Joshua is finished, and he is now the top person in the family, excluding the 1st generation. I have no choice but to worry."

"If Kelliark's purpose is to retrieve not only the white stone but also their magic and artifacts, and he wants to negotiate with me because of that. I will not include that part in the negotiation content. It's impossible to simply return what has been stolen."
Even if they were to negotiate instead of having a frontal battle, she meant that she would never let Jin suffer a loss.
"Having such worries, chairman, do you think I'm a fool?"
It was a joking tone, but no one could laugh.
Only Telrot chuckled and bowed his head.
There were only a few people in the family who could accept Rosa's jokes in this way.
"That's it, I'll end the meeting. Everyone, head to your positions. And Myu and Anne, you two stay for a moment."
